name: stacking-observer-notification-aging
description: This fork's EUI NotificationPanel.lua (VP - EUI Compatibility Files), STACKING OBSERVER NOTIFICATION AGING: while autoplay runs, every NotificationAdded sweeps away (UI.RemoveNotification) the active player's shown notifications older than Stacking_Settings UIObserverNotificationLifetimeTurns (default 3). The dismiss sets the serialized Notification::m_bDismissed.
